headline: Without fiscal stimulus, Magna rises for the first time since March; diesel without complementary subsidy
summary: Diesel is the only fuel left with fiscal support, receiving an 89% IEPS tax credit equal to 6.57 pesos per litre. Magna gasoline no longer has complementary subsidy, per El Economista.
why: Fuel taxes and subsidies feed directly into Mexican inflation, transport costs and Pemex and fuel-retail margins, so changes to them matter to investors in Mexican assets.
original_headline: Sin estímulo fiscal, la Magna por primera vez desde marzo; diésel, sin subsidio complementario
